messages:
Kai: quick RFC follow-up: we need a deterministic router for admission that can pick token vs lease without per-request haggling. Goal: predictable fairness + low-latency for small requests.

Imani: +1. Deterministic rule engine (ordered predicates) seems best: check tenant tier, recent burst-score, and an expect-qps hint. If rule matches, set admit_mode hint and forward.

Omar: important: rules must be evaluable at the edge with only local state. We can include a small local counter + cached central hints (ttl 10s). If central unreachable, fall back to token with penalty multiplier.

Tess: propose API: POST /admit {client_id, hints:{qps_est:int, burst_score:float}} -> {admit:true|false, mode:"token"|"lease", admit_id:"opaque", ttl_ms:"n"}. Keep shape tiny so proxies don't bloat.

Kai: agree. Also persist admit_id in request envelope so downstream components can correlate. For leases admit_id == lease_id, for tokens it's a short opaque token.

Imani: eviction semantics: leases get soft-notice first (evict_after_ms) then hard revoke. Emit events: lease_revoked, lease_grace_expired. We should avoid sudden app-layer disconnects.

Omar: fairness scheduling: with leases we can allocate slot_quota per-epoch. Router attaches slot_hint to request. Scheduling at runtime is simple round-robin across active slots weighted by tenant weight. Tokens remain best-effort.

Tess: important telemetry: admit_mode, admit_outcome, fallback_path, slot_hint, tenant_weight. Create dashboard: admission.paths by mode + 95pct latency per mode. Alert: fallback_rate > 0.2% sustained 5m.

Kai: failure modes: central lease DB partitioned -> increase fallback penalty and reduce canary % automatically. We need a rapid roll-back toggle in Console.

Imani: migration: feature-flagged rollout: dedicated infra tenants first, then 1% prod, 10%, 50%, 100%. Add chaos tests (clock skew, central loss, tombstone replay).

Omar: cost accounting: record per-request unit for tokens and leases to avoid double-billing on fallback—use admit_id to dedupe in billing pipeline. If token->lease happens mid-flight, bill only once based on final admit_id state.

Tess: ops runbook notes: if lease_miss spikes, check central replicas, check cache eviction rate, and if > threshold flip fallback-to-token to true. Pager if fallback_compensate_count > 50 in 5m.

sre-bot: scheduled: "Admission hybrid scrub" Thu 2:30pm PT. Reminder 24h prior.

Kai: owners: eng-platform Kai+Imani, eng-sre Omar. Timeline: spike 1w, prototype 2w, canary 2w. I'll open the RFC follow-up with checklist (schema, dedupe hooks, dashboards, runbook, chaos tests).
